verdict.rationale: Bevy's first-party feature list names glTF loading. Hot-reload of scenes, textures and meshes means imported glTF assets can be iterated on without restarts. The pack has no evidence of FBX or USD import, so only one of the three named interchange formats is covered, and only by a one-line mention. Missing for 10: FBX import, USD import, in-depth glTF import docs (materials, animations, extensions), hands-on corroboration that imports are clean.
